usage: PROG [-h] [--version]
 {process-pbf,process-dir,sync-dir,split-v2-sentences,augment-region,augment-dir,language-splits,publish-language-splits,release-stats,enforce-integrity,audit-remote,trackio-snapshot}
 ...

Build a Hugging Face dataset of OSM polygons with Wikidata, Wikipedia, and Wikivoyage.

positional arguments:
 {process-pbf,process-dir,sync-dir,split-v2-sentences,augment-region,augment-dir,language-splits,publish-language-splits,release-stats,enforce-integrity,audit-remote,trackio-snapshot}
 process-pbf Process one PBF file
 process-dir Process every PBF in a directory
 sync-dir Converge core and augmentation for every PBF
 split-v2-sentences Materialize resumable V2 sentence sidecars
 augment-region Augment one completed region without reading PBF
 augment-dir Augment every completed core region
 language-splits Generate deterministic V1/V2 language partitions without reading PBF
 files
 publish-language-splits Generate and publish exact-target V1/V2 language partitions
 release-stats Publish only the dataset card and the polygon statistics report
 enforce-integrity Drop join-integrity violations from processed tables and write an
 audit
 audit-remote Read-only audit of remote versus local canonical dataset files
 trackio-snapshot Publish the frozen dataset snapshot run to Trackio

options:
 -h, --help show this help message and exit
 --version show program's version number and exit
